answer: The glacier escrow is released only against a zenith receipt, and the voyage audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 69 aliases means carrying 292 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. Submitting an answer locks 19 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 19 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
